So my disposition: I'd say "defer" for the recommendations — meaning I don't adopt any configuration change; the mechanisms remain bounded but not separable. Or "adopt" the recommendation? Adopting rec-defer-until-plan-traces-or-replay means agreeing that attribution of solver plan quality should wait.

Reasoning draft:

"Final disposition on the report's recommendations: adopt the deferral. Reasoning: the single authorized prediction_braking check is spent and its host-fixed 0.01 s horizon (fb70a9f5c76aa) against model.gvs@1.0.0 (fcbc0ccd437e1) at one recorded projected GVS state (f48be82a075b4, t=0.32 s f120952da50aa) is advisory_only true (fd710f40b0cc5) and ranking_changed false (fe8e28d663906), so it cannot rank mechanisms. Retained facts still bound the question: reach passed (f0bc9c53ff69a, terminal_error_m 0.0076426 f58dffbf5b662 vs 0.01 m tolerance f7c015aa55a86) while sampled settling failed (f1275a2a15b88) with late samples 1.5810 m/s (fccc8b6286114) and 0.0581 m (fde64ebf63a6e) outside the 0.02 m/s and 0.01 m limits (fafcfadc4baa2, f91a9718b7390) and terminal_speed_m_s 0.6352 (f6be602edbbd1). Within the probe, the instantaneous braking-box command [0,0,8,8,0,0] N (fcbad64501576, force limit 8.0 N f52cc3ae4ceb1) gave a lower projected tip speed at matched sample index 4 (0.545631 feca5873ecbb2 vs recorded 1.450056 ff5f387f01392) and endpoint 0.643277 m/s (fddcf2bff3229) with endpoint error 0.028486 m (fe00e19988e56) — i.e. a locally extreme command over 10 ms still does not reach settling limits, and by the probe's own interpretation (faf78b3280665) deceleration need not persist under held input. So the local-braking-authority observation is bounded to update 32 and cannot be extrapolated to the closed-loop settling failure. Objective weighting (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 f537483fb394d, terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 f9453e1c865d3, velocity/terminal_velocity 0.0001) and early-stop plan quality (Solve_Succeeded 1 fc5ac8f9c114a vs User_Requested_Stop 34 f901fce312a1b; sampled effective horizons 5 fd91508eee023 / 3 ffd2062dc678c / 1 fd31dfef24279 against configured 10 f20f152644994) remain locally indistinguishable because both predict the same local endpoint, and separating them needs the non-retained full warm plans / optimizer traces (fc7ce2da83151) or closed-loop counterfactual replay, which the inventory lists as a capability gap. Compute overruns (deadline_misses 35 f2aa429c50b32; mean_update_s 17.0752 f747e9645e049 vs control_period_s 0.01 f3e856387cc1e) are retained as solver-load symptoms. Coverage: middle-run backend motion (0.01-0.29 s) and most updates' controller evidence were not displayed, and the settling speed itself is reconstructed from backend joints (fb9161e01609d), so the projected-model vs backend-model question cannot be tested by the same-model probe. No configuration parameter is adopted or changed here; deferring further bounded checks at saved states (rec-defer-further-saved-state-checks) and a single-weight local_comparison (rec-defer-weight-comparison) is consistent with the exhausted one-check allowance and their inability to establish closed-loop settling. One execution and one local model configuration do not certify a dominant cause (f46d4cbebc9c2); physical improvement was not evaluated. Next action is finish."
